project_info.theme: Ingredient-complex visual explaining natural UV absorption support
project_info.color_palette: Soft Pink, Sky Blue, White, Lotus Pink, Warm Brown, Beige

main_subject.detail: A pastel infographic featuring a floating pink lotus petal, pongamia seed pod, and licorice root arranged inside soft translucent circular bubbles beneath the arced text 'PHỨC HỢP HẤP THỤ TIA UV TỰ NHIÊN'.
main_subject.style: Ingredient-story science graphic, soft skincare infographic, airy translucent-circle composition

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'CHIẾT XUẤT SEN', 'PHỨC HỢP HẤP THỤ TIA UV TỰ NHIÊN', 'RỄ CAM THẢO', and 'HẠT ĐẬU DẦU'.
items: Top Left: Curved white text 'CHIẾT XUẤT SEN' wrapping around the lotus-petal bubble.
Top Right: Large arced headline 'PHỨC HỢP HẤP THỤ TIA UV TỰ NHIÊN' across the top-right circle.
Bottom Left: Smaller bubble containing licorice roots labeled 'RỄ CAM THẢO'.
Bottom Right: Medium bubble containing an opened brown seed pod labeled 'HẠT ĐẬU DẦU'.
Center/Background: Large translucent circles layered over a pink-to-blue gradient field, with a floating dewy lotus petal in the left bubble.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glassy bubble translucency, gentle ingredient highlights, airy pastel science mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for an ingredient-complex infographic about natural UV absorption support. Surrounding elements: curved white labels 'CHIẾT XUẤT SEN', 'RỄ CAM THẢO', 'HẠT ĐẬU DẦU', and the large arced headline 'PHỨC HỢP HẤP THỤ TIA UV TỰ NHIÊN'. Keep the soft glassy-circle layering, the ingredient cutout realism, and the airy scientific beauty aesthetic. Technical style: high fidelity ingredient infographic design, soft infographic lighting, glassy bubble translucency and gentle ingredient highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
